description: This file defines the SdkActionManager class for managing custom events within an embed SDK, including event firing, listening, and parsing actions. It also includes type definitions for event data and payloads related to booking and embed states.

classes.name: SdkActionManager
classes.description: A class to manage custom event actions, including firing events, subscribing, and parsing action types within the embed SDK.

methods.name: parseAction
methods.description: Parses a full action type string into its namespace and type components if it follows the 'CAL' prefix format.

methods.name: getFullActionName
methods.description: Constructs the full action name string with namespace for event dispatching.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires a custom event with the specified name and data, including a wildcard event.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers an event listener for a specific event name.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Removes an event listener for a specific event name.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SdkActionManager with an optional namespace.
